fullDescription:
Draw with paint brushes and pencils for Procreate, create a realistic drawing effect with the brushes that we developed by carefully comparing with real-life counterparts. The brushes are even better than we expected, so it’s safe to say that this set will come in handy for every artist, as it contains 47 high-quality brushes, including 4 paper textures. Apply a paper texture on top of your drawing and get an incredibly impressive paper effect on your drawing that will make your art even more realistic and unique.

  Brush Set contains:  Pencil Brushes  Mechanical Pencil Brushes Various pencils including Graphite Pencil  Marker Brushes  Ballpoint Brush and other Pens  Hatching brushes  Smudge brushes  Blender brushes  4 brushes for texturing paper  And many more useful tools

▶︎ How to install:

After purchase, you will be provided with a link to download the file(s). Open the downloaded file on your iPad via Procreate. The downloaded brushset will automatically install and become available for use.

If you have any problems with the installation then let me know! 

**The brushes only work on Procreate
